deprecation_criterion: Superseded by the next work-intake housekeep wave's baseline; a re-bloat regression guard for the post-#359 doc surfaces.
description: Re-anchored for issue #359 (measured doc reduction of spec.md). This wave slimmed restated rationale from Purpose and Determinism & testability without dropping any load-bearing token, taking spec.md from 247 to 244 measured lines. This baseline now records the post-#359 doc line counts plus a one-line margin, so the housekeep gate continues as a re-bloat regression guard (current docs must stay STRICTLY smaller than this) while the load-bearing-token + cleanup gates remain intact.
